_comment: cc-nexs per-requirement configuration. The orchestrator reads this file at startup to determine the pipeline mode.

_mode_options.lean: Default token-saving flow; plan gate, parallel implementation, local integration verification, a single consolidated review, test acceptance, and release gate
_mode_options.full: Full five-party flow; development may span multiple sprints, and once all development is complete, integration review, test release, final QA, and Evaluator acceptance are handled in one unified pass
_mode_options.fast: Three-role single sprint; small multi-end requirements are implemented in parallel by repository wave, followed by code review and a unified TEST_RELEASE
_mode_options.lite: Lightweight flow (Tech Lead → self-test → commit) that skips the spec and the Evaluator; suited to very small changes
_mode_options.hotfix: Bug-fix flow, automatically tiered by P0/P1/P2/P3

_mode_selection_guidance.Use full when: Multiple sprints, DB schema / breaking contracts / compliance risk, or complex cross-end dependencies
_mode_selection_guidance.Use fast when: Single sprint, diff ≤ 800 lines; may include parallel frontend/backend implementation when contracts are frozen and the work spans different repositories

_skip_human_gate_warning: When true, skip the manual checkpoint after spec review. Use only for demos or urgent hotfixes; keep false for normal requirements.
